chirp_perfect_separability_note: Chirp sweeps produce unique start/end/sweep feature combinations; near-perfect separability is expected on synthetic chirp class.

root_causes.name: benign_envelope_mimics_ook
root_causes.detail: Benign ambient envelope features yield high duty_cycle (~0.82), overlapping OOK modulation statistics and causing benign->ook confusion.

recommended_generator_fixes: Add continuous in-band benign variants (steady_ultrasonic_hum, band_limited_hiss)
Do not treat squelched ambient as legitimate benign diversity
